plan.question: Does negative brightness apply the same multiplier independently to R, G and B?
hypotheses: H1: RGB'=floor(RGB*(1+b/100)), clipped to [0,255]; alpha unchanged. Supported by the supplied +17 observation.
H3: Negative brightness subtracts 255*abs(b)/100, then floors and clips.
predictions: Inactive channels remain 0 and alpha remains 255 under all three hypotheses; compare all three channel profiles.
plan.usefulness: Fresh negative test distinguishes transfer laws and channel-specific behavior. Require exact brightness-0 roundtrip first; freeze every other control at 0.
